description: Issue #178, the non-regression half and the record of a decision. The body carries all three heading spellings the issue named — 未決 / undecided / open questions — and NO fenced block, and the planner reads nothing out of them: `questions` stays empty and the run is a clean success. Heading detection was considered and NOT adopted (see the commit that added this case): a heading is prose, and reading prose into a stop is the same category error acceptance-gates-notation.md section 5 refuses for gates. The `expected-plan.json` here was generated by the runner AT HEAD, before the open-questions block existed, so this case is a byte-for-byte assertion that a body without the block plans exactly as it did before — not merely that it looks reasonable now.
